factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for gopher rockfish.
factors.value_notes: The reviewed CDFW/ODFW species accounts document rocky-reef habitat and geographic range but do not establish a numeric preferred sea-surface-temperature interval. No species-specific adult SST preference or catch-response evidence was found to validate the configured 10-17 °C range or 12-16 °C ideal. Keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for gopher rockfish.
factors.value_notes: A CDFW distribution account reports adults to about 80 m, most commonly 10-35 m; ODFW describes rocky areas to 40 fathoms and notes common occurrence in shallower water. This supports the broad 2-50 m outer band, but not the 4-45 m ideal as a measured preference curve.
